for PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE, INSPECTION, AND REPAIR OF SOLVENT TANKS PPP&M OPERATIONS, 2D COMBAT READINESS REGIMENT MARINE CORPS BASE CAMP LEJEUNE, NC 1.0 Scope. This Performance Work Statement (PWS) outlines the requirements for maintenance, servicing, waste disposal, material replenishment, and preventive maintenance support for four (4) Ultrasonic Solvent tanks utilized in support of Preservation, Packaging, Packing, and Marking (PPP&M) operations aboard Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, North Carolina. The 2d Combat Readiness Regiment, PPP&M Platoon serves as the primary effort in support of cleaning, preservation, and packaging requirements for equipment and weapon systems supporting II Marine Expeditionary Force (II MEF) operations and training exercises. The objective of this requirement is to ensure the ultrasonic solvent tanks remain fully operational in support of mission-essential PPP&M functions and in accordance with MIL-STD-2073 requirements for military preservation and packing. Services shall include routine cleaning, servicing, replenishment of cleaning solutions and preservative oils, waste manifesting and disposal, and preventive maintenance necessary to sustain operational readiness, maintain equipment effectiveness, minimize downtime, and extend equipment

For established systems, the water can be cultured monthly (or at least quarterly) unless a greater frequency is dictated by historical data at a given institution. Water samples should be collected directly from outlet taps situated in different parts of the water distribution system. In general, the sample taps should be opened and the water allowed to run for at least 60 seconds before a sample is aseptically collected in a sterile, endotoxin-free container. The collection container should not be made of polypropylene, because polypropylene has been shown to inhibit endotoxin detection (Roslansky, et al., 1991). At least 100 to 300 mL of water should be collected. Sample taps should not be treated with disinfectants. If treatment of taps is desired, alcohol should be used. The sample should not be collected until all the alcohol has evaporated so that no disinfectant residual will be left in the sample. Bleach or other disinfectant solutions should never be used. Bacterial replication is prevented by holding the sample on ice (or at 4°C [39.2°F]) until it is delivered to the laboratory for testing. Dear Prospective Quoter: SUBJECT: Chancery Swimming Pool Changing Room Refurbishment The Embassy of the United States of America invites you to submit a quotation for the procurement of Chancery Swimming Pool Changing Room Refurbishment in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The Embassy intends to award a single purchase order / contract for the required services. Kindly refer to the attached scope of work (SOW) for further details. Your quotation must be submitted electronically to KualaLumpurDTO@state.gov marked “Quotation Enclosed – Chancery Swimming Pool” to the Contracting Officer, General Services Office, Kuala Lumpur on or before 12:00 noon on August 23, 2026. No quotations will be accepted after that time. For any quotations above $40,000 USD, the Contractor must have valid and active registration in SAM.gov at the time of proposal submission. Direct any questions regarding this solicitation to the Procurement Agent, Prema by email at rmuthupillaip@state.gov during regular business hours. Sincerely, Farouk Khan Contracting Of

The project's primary goal is to replace the existing deteriorated finishes and fixtures, and install new modern, durable materials and equipment to restore functionality, improve aesthetics, and ensure compliance with health and safety standards. The contractor shall provide all necessary labor, expertise, equipment, materials, and oversight to complete the upgrading works in a safe, professional, and timely manner. As part

tor must comply with FAR 48 CFR 52.222-50, "Combating Trafficking in Persons", to prevent forced labor and human trafficking in the performance of this contract. OBJECTIVES The primary objectives of this project are: To refresh the swimming pool toilet and changing room facilities to meet modern standards of functionality, hygiene and aesthetics. To replace plumbing, electrical and ventilation systems to meet current safety and operational standards. To ensure all work is performed in compliance with applicable U.S. and local safety, health, and environmental regulations. To ensure ethical labor practices and compliance with anti-trafficking requirements as outlined in FAR 52.222-50. To complete all works with minimal disruption to Embassy operations and swimming pool facility users. DOSAR Additional Safety Measures: The contractor shall comply with DOSAR 652.236-70 and any additional safety measures outlined in this SOW. Work-Specific Safety and Health Requirements: The contractor shall develop a Safety and Health Plan and Activity Hazard Analyses (AHAs) that address hazards identified in the SOW. references_experience.text:
ifically, this assignment will provide clear picture of the present state of waste collection, segregation, diversion, transport, processing and disposal. Furthermore, this assignment shall identify gaps between policy requirements and actual practice at the barangays, cities, municipalities and offer evidence to guide planning, resource allocation and capacity-building. The firm shall also establish a benchmark to measure progress as implementation unfolds. The projected implementation period should not exceed more than eight (8) months and is projected to start within the 3rd quarter of this year. 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment is attached to this request for expressions of interest.

The MMDA now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are: 

1.) The firm should have at least five (5) completed or on-going solid waste management project.

2.) The firm should have experience in conducting work with Bilateral/Multilateral Development Organizations as well as the Philip

in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected. Consultants shall have a country presence with experience working with developing countries through the firm’s own branches, consortium of sub-contracting with local firms.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultants’ Qualifications (CQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

For further information, please visit the BAC Office at the 18th Floor or Project Management Office (PMO) at the 16th Floor, MMDA New Building Dona Julia Vargas Ave. Cor. Molave St. Brgy. Ugong Pasig City for the Terms of Reference (TOR) during office hours (7:00 AM to 4:00 PM), Monday to Thursday.

In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected. Consultants shall have a country presence with experience working with developing countries through the firm’s own branches, consortium of sub-contracting with local firms.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultants’ Qualifications (CQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

egion (NCR) to inform the design of the proposed Clean Metro Manila, in particular for the provision of performance-based grants. The consulting firm will be required to undertake strategic assessment of policy, institutional, governance, technical/service delivery and financial aspects and provide recommendations on the potential solutions/model to fill the existing gaps to inform the project design of Clean Metro Manila. Specifically, this assignment will provide clear picture of the present state of waste collection, segregation, diversion, transport, processing and disposal. Furthermore, this assignment shall identify gaps between policy requirements and actual practice at the barangays, cities, municipalities and offer evidence to guide planning, resource allocation and capacity-building. The firm shall also establish a benchmark to measure progress as implementation unfolds. The projected implementation period should not exceed more than eight (8) months and is projected to start within the 3rd quarter of this year. 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment is attached to this request for expressions of interest.

sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks.
